The receipt (COORD-plan-upstream-amendment-20261003.json:4,45-49) and the recheck mandate (COORD-upstream-20261003.json:257, "Amend only execution/preflight ownership and verification requirements") describe an additive tooling amendment.   - a console audit entrypoint that accepts --phase
